description: Defines an abstract base class for Drupal field widget plugins related to options-based widgets (like select, radios, checkboxes). Implements form element handling, validation, and options retrieval.

classes.name: OptionsWidgetBase
classes.description: An abstract class for options-based field widgets in Drupal, providing common functionality for form handling, options management, and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the widget, setting the column property based on field storage property names.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Builds the form element for the widget, setting validation and key column.

methods.name: validateElement
methods.description: Validates the form element, ensuring required fields are filled and processing submitted values.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the options list for the widget, including alterations and flattening.

methods.name: getSelectedOptions
methods.description: Determines which options are selected based on field items.

methods.name: supportsGroups
methods.description: Indicates whether the widget supports option groups; defaults to FALSE.

methods.name: sanitizeLabel
methods.description: Sanitizes option labels allowing limited HTML.

methods.name: getEmptyLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for an empty option, defaulting to NULL.
